spec_match.rationale: Composes the setters with real MediaStreamTracks to test the spec's pause-policy steps (track muted after resolve) and the optional hidden-document rejection; only infers a pause policy from an observed muted-state CHANGE.

interactive.rationale: Opt-in capture (A/V or audio-only), four await-setter buttons, a delayed hidden-tab unmute with cancel, live track readout and timestamped timeline.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card promises promise-settle vs mute/unmute ordering and the hidden unmute case; both present.

edge_cases.rationale: No-capture, capture-denied, cancelled schedule and 'nothing to unmute' branches are handled; the real pause-policy and hidden-rejection branches cannot occur on Chromium, so they were not observed.

conformance.rationale: Is the named observation route for the manual pause-policy-track-muted assertion.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified with headless Chrome for Testing 153 via Playwright (chrome-devtools-mcp is NOT available in this environment, so this is not DevTools-MCP verification). Chrome 153 has the OLD shape; the new-shape branches were exercised only with a test-only init-script shim in the harness (never shipped). Fake devices granted A/V tracks; after setMicrophoneActive(false) muted stayed false (no pause policy in Chromium, reported as such); setXActive(true) reported 'nothing to unmute'; cancel and 5 s delayed call ran (visible). An early build wrongly claimed a pause policy when muted stayed false after (true) — fixed and re-verified. Zero console errors.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5188639100370944 plus the spec section and MDN/WebIDL/HTML references relevant to this concept.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only (bg-paper/stone/ivory, text-charcoal/black/muted, accent-emerald-dark/rose/blue/amber-as-border-only); every button override sets both background and color; no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: Start/stop move focus to the next useful control so it is never lost on disable; cancel button receives focus while a call is scheduled; verdicts aria-live polite; the timeline is a non-live output to avoid announcement spam.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at 360x740 (DPR 3, touch, isMobile) and 1280x800: 0px horizontal overflow on both, button rows wrap, 44px targets, screenshots read for both classes.

telemetry_health.rationale: demo-telemetry.js loaded; showcaseTelemetry.assert fires for the primary contract and for the legacy/fallback branch with the raw shape/state as details.

openQuestions.title: Observe a real pause policy
openQuestions.detail: Safari 18.4+ implements Promise<undefined>; check whether it applies a pause policy (tracks muted after setMicrophoneActive(false)) and record the observed ordering of resolve vs mute events.

openQuestions.title: Headed hidden-tab run
openQuestions.detail: Headless stays 'visible'; run the delayed unmute in a headed browser with the tab backgrounded and record whether Chromium resolves or rejects.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region for asynchronous result announcements
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use aria-live=polite for standard result/status updates; reserve assertive for critical interruptions; avoid announcing interstitial 'loading' noise.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdicts/readouts are aria-live polite; per-call result cards and logs are NOT live (they are navigable on demand) to avoid spam.

guidanceConsulted.query: toggle button aria-pressed mute microphone camera
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Communicate toggle state with aria-pressed, style :focus-visible, keep targets >=24px (bumped on coarse pointers).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All buttons min-height 44px with :focus-visible outline in --accent-blue; toggles (call page) expose aria-pressed and aria-busy while awaiting.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: flex-wrap:wrap on button rows, min-inline-size:0 on items holding long strings, auto-fit/minmax grids, never mask overflow with overflow:hidden.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Button groups wrap; result grids use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%,Npx),1fr)); outputs use overflow-wrap:anywhere; measured 0px horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800.

summary: The most advanced angle: real capture tracks measured against the promise, honestly reporting that Chromium applies no pause policy while showing exactly what a UA that does would change.
